note: MDL is a Navratna Defence PSU shipyard (Ministry of Defence). Domestic supply is confirmed by named vessel deliveries/acceptance documents to the Indian Navy and Indian Coast Guard, plus an in-build export order (MPV Y21001 for Navi Merchants, Denmark) that has not yet shipped. No completed export shipment under HS 890110/890190 with date, destination and B/L number was found in free customs views — the customs footprint is import-side (main engines, valves, submarine interfaces from ThyssenKrupp Marine Systems, Naval Group, Everllence). Declared HS 890110/890190 is plausible for the product line but is not evidenced by any export record; per project rules this is not a rejection ground. Export revenue split: null (not public in retrieved sources).
